about_the_game:
Uncover the Mysteries of Valaar and Command the Power of the Vizarri

Vizarri: Adventures of Valaar is a 2D, top-down monster-taming RPG you don't want to miss. Set on the exotic and mysterious planet of Valaar, many adventures await. As a newly appointed trainer, you’ll embark on a journey to explore a vibrant world inhabited by mystical creatures known by the locals as Vizarri - each with their own elemental types, special abilities, and evolutionary trees.

Wild Vizarri have a short lifespan unless bonded to the Vizanctuary, a sanctuary in another dimension that preserves their spirits. Trainers can use high-tech devices called ViziLinks to link Vizarri to the Vizanctuary, granting them eternal life. This also allows them to be summoned into battle from anywhere in the overworld. How many Vizarri will you capture?

With a team of up to 5 Vizarri, you’ll engage in turn-based battles across a dynamic 3x4 grid of tiles. Strategic positioning and precise timing will be just as important as raw strength and speed. How will you command your team of Vizarri in battle?

Key Features:

  • Explore a vast world consisting of multiple biomes

  • Assemble your team of Vizarri

  • Engage in strategic, turn-based battles on a 3x4 grid of tiles

  • Manage a comprehensive inventory system with balanced storage constraints

  • Buy and sell items from merchant NPCs

  • Uncover hidden secrets, stories, and Vizarri lore

  • View a help menu at any time by simply pressing the 'H' key

  • Save your progress with the Steam-integrated saving system

Details by the numbers:

  • 39 obtainable items (including zeyra potion, shovel, gold coin, sacred ring, and more)

  • 13 elemental types (leaf, water, fire, air, earth, phantom, bebe, basic, venom, rock, ice, cosmic, and thymogen)

  • 10 unique Vizarri (including Fleem, Budli, Arcana, Pam-Pam, and more)

  • 3 save slots

  • 1 planet (Valaar)

Important Notes:

  • The game reads input from your keyboard. Mouse input is ignored. Game remotes are not supported at this time.

  • A computer running Windows 10 or later is required to play.

  • The game is under active development by a solo developer. This is an incredible feat. Be warned that despite being playable, bugs are likely to be encountered and fixed one at a time. Features planned for the future include expanding the roster of Vizarri, expanding the world map, and adding support for online multiplayer battles.

Whether you're in it for the strategy, the world-building, or the lore, Vizarri: Adventures of Valaar invites you to tame the untamed - and explore the unexplored.

name: Vizarri
short_description: A monster-taming RPG set on the planet of Valaar. Capture and train mystical creatures known by the locals as Vizarri. Battle other trainers in tactical, turn-based combat on a dynamic grid. Explore islands, collect items, and outsmart a rising enemy force. These are the Adventures of Valaar.
